messages:
Elise: Short postmortem follow-up from the GPU capacity blip. Putting owners + minimal checklist here so we can close the loop quickly. Root cause summary: large queued batch spikes + autoscaler cooldowns + quota headroom reached.
Omar: Can we have concrete owners, ETA, and acceptance criteria? I can handle scheduler changes.
Elise: Proposed actions: 1) Scheduler: lower preempt threshold and tweak binpack weights (owner: Omar, ETA 48h). 2) Autoscaler: reduce scale-down grace to 20s and set min-headroom 12% (owner: Jin, ETA 24h). 3) Quota: request provisional +25% GPUs for a 48h validation window (ticket CAP-7010, owner: Elise, submit today). 4) Runbook: add surge triage checklist + paste-ready commands and escalation matrix (owner: Elise, ETA PR by EOD). 5) Monitoring: add surge-rate/per-hour chart and a weekly recurrence alert (owner: ops, ETA next week). Acceptance: CAP approved OR >=50% reduction in surge incidents over two weeks.
Jin: I'll run a canary in staging and share perf graphs. Snippet for runbook: ```
# quick scale up
kubectl scale deploy gpu-batcher -n inference --replicas=40
# patch autoscaler
kubectl patch cm autoscaler-config -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"scaleDownGrace":"20s","minHeadroom":"0.12"}}'
```
Omar: Scheduler note: will add priority class for small realtime pods and a perf gate test. Uploading results in 36h.
Elise: CAP-7010 opened: https://infra.company/tickets/CAP-7010 (provisional +25% for 48h). pinging billing for fast approve. @ops-bot please create follow-up calendar.
ops-bot: Task created: CAP-7010. Calendar invite: GPU-capacity-validate 2025-06-12 09:00 PT. Reminder set for owners.
Elise: Owners recap: Omar (scheduler), Jin (autoscaler), Elise (quota + runbook), ops (monitoring). Quick sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to review staging. Weekly check-ins for 3 weeks after closure. If anyone needs backup handoff, reply here.
Jin: :thumbsup:
Omar: Adding tasks to sprint board and will link PRs.
Elise: Thanks all, I'll update the incident tracker and mark follow-up as in-progress.
